comparison: 5DC-v1A-P baseline vs same-bar fix applied engine

same_bar_fix_details.problem_before_fix:
Same-bar trades (order_date == exit_fill.fill_date) had exits silently dropped:
- Symbol stayed 'open' with its original entry until a later unrelated trade closed the position
- 136 trades were incorrectly fused (two different trades' entry and exit merged into one)
- 10 positions reported still open at backtest end
- Fabricated closed positions via unrelated close events
same_bar_fix_details.fix_implementation:
same_bar_exit_candidates list: exits on same date as entry are held back
- After entry is admitted via process_day(), a second process_day() call for the same date retries the same-bar exits
- Symbol check: symbol in portfolio.open_positions before admitting the exit
- Preserves separate identity of each trade's entry and exit
same_bar_fix_details.quantitative_impact_of_fix:
Based on code analysis and trend_breakout_v1 audit:
- Before fix: 136 trades fused incorrectly per trend_breakout_v1 audit
- Before fix: 10 positions stuck open at backtest end per trend_breakout_v1 audit
- For 5DC-v1A-P: exact same-bar trade count change not separately reported in baseline
- The baseline (848 closed positions) already includes the fix applied
- If fix were removed: some of 848 positions would be affected, potentially reducing effective trade count or changing PnL attribution

conclusion: The 5DC-v1A-P SMOKE baseline already includes the same-bar fix (engine commit b5fc50df9046c68d858452d414456dadbea8fe8f). The baseline metrics (848 trades, 27.95% win rate, -1.21% CAGR, -30.9% MDD, 0.95 profit factor) reflect the fixed engine behavior. The same-bar fix prevents 136 trade fusions and 10 stuck positions that would occur without the fix (as documented in the trend_breakout_v1 audit). Direct quantitative comparison between pre-fix and post-fix 5DC-v1A-P results cannot be performed because: (1) the baseline already has the fix applied, (2) re-running the engine with the fix removed is prohibited per AGENTS.md §7/§14, and (3) running new simulations would modify the repository state. The inferred behavioral difference is: before fix → same-bar exits silently dropped, positions fused incorrectly; after fix → same-bar exits properly retried, each trade's entry/exit preserved separately.
